text:
alex.sales: Hey team — EdgePayments demo (preauth flow) is in ~2h and they're seeing lots of 429s during a quick replay of transactions. Need triage.

sarah-sales: Can you paste the error headers / sample log? Are these 429s coming from per-route caps or global quota?

alex.sales: sample from their client run:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 2000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 60
Retry-After: 60
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","route":"/v1/embeddings","tenant":"edgepayments-demo"}
```
They're firing ~40 concurrent embedding calls (many ~60-120 tokens).

devon-eng: Looking at our audit logs for tenant edgepayments-demo — same pattern. Lots of small concurrent requests hitting the per-route token cap (we currently count tokens against per-route cap, not just per-request concurrency). Hypothesis: client parallelizes many small calls which exhausts the token budget window quickly.

linh-ml: Embedding workload often causes this since tokens accumulate per request. For demos, small high-concurrency calls are worst-case. Options: ask client to batch client-side, or we temporarily bump per-route token cap / extend burst window for demo.

mateo-ops: I can do a temporary per-route cap increase and create a short reservation. Propose: raise /v1/embeddings per-route token budget from 2k -> 10k tokens/min for tenant edgepayments-demo for 3 hours, enable request queueing with max_concurrency=8 and set Retry-After guidance to 120s. That should smooth the demo. Any objections?

sarah-sales: That sounds good. Also want to surface pricing impact to the customer — bumping quota could affect overage. Alex, can you confirm they'll accept the temporary lift (sales note)?

alex.sales: Confirmed they'll accept for the live demo. They want minimal risk of interruption. Also asked about long-term fix for production.

devon-eng: For production we should recommend either client-side batching or a small proxy that coalesces embedding requests, and enable automatic prefix/KV caching if they do repeated prompts. We'll also add config notes:
- prefer batching to 1 call per user session where possible
- set exponential backoff with jitter (start 500ms)
- use streaming or single multi-input embed call to reduce token accounting overhead

linh-ml: Can also suggest model variant with higher throughput / lower token cost for embeddings if they care about unit economics.

mateo-ops: Performing changes now. Creating a reservation: edgepayments-demo -> per-route /v1/embeddings tokens/min = 10000 (window=60s) and setting queue max_concurrency=8. Will add audit note and expiry at +3h.

deploy-bot: quota-service: change applied for tenant edgepayments-demo (/v1/embeddings) by mateo-ops — id=resv_9f3b — expires in 3h.

sarah-sales: Thanks — Alex can you run a quick replay and confirm 429s gone? Also I'll ping billing about the temporary bump for cost heads-up.

alex.sales: Replay now... much better, only sparse Retry-After spikes as queueing backfills. Demo green. :tada:

devon-eng: Follow-ups (tracked):
- Add a short KB for presales demos recommending: concurrency limits, batching examples, quick per-tenant temp bump playbook.
- Engineering: evaluate making per-route token-window configurable per-tenant (hard to expose broadly but useful).

linh-ml: I'll draft embeddings best-practices snippet to add to presales kit.

mateo-ops: I kept logs and metrics for the window to validate. Will revert reservation at expiry unless you request extension.

alex.sales: Great work all — saved the demo. I'll update the customer and close the loop.
